Name: Festival of the Mundane
Author: MouseyPounds
Description:
[b]Description:

[color=#ffff00]Festival of the Mundane[/color][/b] is a combination SMAPI mod & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url] Content Pack which changes the Sewer map on the day of Spirit's Eve to a celebration full of Shadow people. There are many costumed Shadows to interact with, a small minigame with prizes, a swimming area, and special hats to purchase. Some of the hats have a side effect which can be quite useful outside of the festival.



[b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url].
[*]Unzip the download and place the included [color=#b6d7a8][code]FestivalOfTheMundane[/code][/color] folder into your [color=#b6d7a8][code]Mods[/code][/color] folder.
[/list]


[b]Compatibility:
[/b][list][*][b][color=#ffff00]Festival of the Mundane[/color][/b] requires [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] version 3.0.0 or higher and should work with Stardew Valley 1.4 or higher. It also requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url].
[*]This mod completely replaces the sewer map on a specific day and may not be compatible with other mods that replace or alter that map.
[/list]


[b]Additional Notes:
[/b][list]
[*]Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1949074]hatmouse[/url] for help with initial concepts and support.
[*]This mod was made as part of the [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/StardewValley]discord server's[/url] Fall event, but is opted out of any prize awards for the modding contest.
[*]The mod was created with some help from the Stardew Valley team, but none of its contents should be considered canon.
[*]All mod-added hats are only available for purchase during the festival; they will not show up at Hatmouse's regular shop.
[*]Special Hat effect: [spoiler]The Shadow masks work like the Slime Charmer ring and prevent all damage from Shadow-type enemies in combat.[/spoiler]
[/list]
